cd /workspace && timeout 900 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random, itertools, json, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref
rng = random.Random(11)
found = 0
checked = 0
for trial in range(20000):
    n = rng.randint(3, 6)
    pool = list(range(1, n+1))
    npaths = rng.randint(2, 6)
    paths = []
    for _ in range(npaths):
        k = rng.randint(2, min(n, 5))
        p = rng.sample(pool, k)
        paths.append((tuple(p), rng.randint(1,3)))
    agg = ref.aggregate(paths, set())
    _l,_r,final = ref.peel_naive(agg)
    core = sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
    if not core or len(core) > 8: continue
    occ = ref.occurrences(final, core)
    checked += 1
    Z, marg = ref.brute(occ)
    if Z == 0:
        found += 1
        if found <= 2:
            doc = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[{"path":list(p),"count":c} for p,c in paths],
                   "priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[list(e) for e in core],"queries":[]}
            print(json.dumps(doc))
            out = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
            print('  ->', out.stdout.decode().strip()[:120])
        if found >= 2: break
print('checked', checked, 'zero-partition found', found)
EOF
